extracted.intended_audience: patent practitioners, applicants, and USPTO examiners dealing with international design (Hague) applications
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance on filing, examination, prosecution, and national processing of international design applications under the Hague Agreement as handled by the USPTO (MPEP Chapter 2900).

rubrics_metrics.name: Basic Hague Agreement Principles
rubrics_metrics.description: Fundamental principles governing international design applications filed under the Hague Agreement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Definitions
rubrics_metrics.description: Defined terms used in the chapter and in relation to international design applications.

rubrics_metrics.name: Declarations under the Hague Agreement Made by the United States of America
rubrics_metrics.description: Declarations and positions the United States has made under the Hague Agreement that affect international design applications.

rubrics_metrics.name: Who May File An International Design Application
rubrics_metrics.description: Standards and eligibility rules identifying who is entitled to file an international design application.

rubrics_metrics.name: Where to File An International Design Application
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules specifying the competent offices and locations for filing an international design application.

rubrics_metrics.name: Filing Through the USPTO as an Office of Indirect Filing
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedures and requirements for filing an international design application via the USPTO acting as an office of indirect filing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Filing Date Requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirements that must be met to establish a filing date for an international design application.

rubrics_metrics.name: International Registration and Date of the International Registration
rubrics_metrics.description: Standards for the international registration itself and determination of the international registration date.

rubrics_metrics.name: Filing Date in the United States
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules for determining the effective U.S. filing date of an international design application designating the United States.

rubrics_metrics.name: Contents of the International Design Application
rubrics_metrics.description: Required contents (parts and information) that must be included in an international design application.

rubrics_metrics.name: Official Form for the Application for International Registration
rubrics_metrics.description: Use and requirements of the official form(s) for applying for international registration under the Hague Agreement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reproductions (Drawings)
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirements and standards for reproductions (drawings, images) submitted in support of an international design application.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reproductions Submitted Through the USPTO Patent Electronic Filing System
rubrics_metrics.description: Specific requirements and procedures for submitting reproductions via the USPTO's electronic filing system.

rubrics_metrics.name: Annexes
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules governing annexes to the international design application (additional documents or materials submitted as annexes).

rubrics_metrics.name: International Design Application Fees
rubrics_metrics.description: Fee requirements, calculation, and payment procedures applicable to international design applications.

rubrics_metrics.name: Representation
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules on representation (e.g., who may represent applicants before the Office) in the context of international design applications.

rubrics_metrics.name: Correspondence in Respect of International Design Applications Filed With the USPTO as an Office of Indirect Filing
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedures and requirements for correspondence related to international design applications filed through the USPTO as an indirect filing office.

rubrics_metrics.name: Relief from Prescribed Time Limits
rubrics_metrics.description: Standards and procedures for requesting and obtaining relief (e.g., extensions or reinstatement) from prescribed time limits for international design applications.

rubrics_metrics.name: Conversion of an International Design Application to a Design Application Under 35 U.S.C. Chapter 16
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedures, requirements, and consequences for converting an international design application into a U.S. design application under Chapter 16.

rubrics_metrics.name: National Processing of International Design Applications Designating the United States
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedures and standards the USPTO follows when nationally processing an international design application that designates the United States.

rubrics_metrics.name: Inventorship
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules and criteria for determining inventorship in the context of international design applications.

rubrics_metrics.name: Applicant
rubrics_metrics.description: Standards and requirements identifying who is the applicant and how applicant status is determined for international design applications.

rubrics_metrics.name: Correspondence Address
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirements and guidance for providing and updating a correspondence address for international design applications designating the United States.

rubrics_metrics.name: Elements of a Nonprovisional International Design Application
rubrics_metrics.description: Required elements for a nonprovisional international design application as processed nationally, including specification, reproductions, and oath/declaration.

rubrics_metrics.name: Specification (element)
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirement that a specification (as applicable) must be included and meet applicable standards in a nonprovisional international design application.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reproductions (Drawing Figures) (element)
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirements for drawing figures/reproductions when included as elements of a nonprovisional international design application.

rubrics_metrics.name: Inventor’s Oath or Declaration (element)
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirement for an inventor's oath or declaration as an element of a nonprovisional international design application.

rubrics_metrics.name: Examination
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedures, standards, and criteria applied during examination of international design applications designating the United States.

rubrics_metrics.name: Notification of Refusal
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedures and grounds for issuance of a notification of refusal with respect to an international design application.

rubrics_metrics.name: One Independent and Distinct Design
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirement that an application claim only one independent and distinct design (criteria for unity/entitlement).

rubrics_metrics.name: Considerations Under 35 U.S.C. 112
rubrics_metrics.description: Application of the written description, definiteness, and other 35 U.S.C. §112 considerations to international design applications.

rubrics_metrics.name: Foreign Priority
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules for claiming foreign priority in international design applications and how such claims affect filing and rights.

rubrics_metrics.name: Benefit Claims Under 35 U.S.C. 386(c)
rubrics_metrics.description: Standards and procedures for claiming benefit of earlier-filed applications under 35 U.S.C. 386(c) in the international/Hague context.

rubrics_metrics.name: Information Disclosure Statement in an International Design Application Designating the United States
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirements and procedures for submitting an information disclosure statement (IDS) in an international design application designating the United States.

rubrics_metrics.name: Allowance
rubrics_metrics.description: Criteria and procedures leading to allowance of a design application following national processing of an international design application.

rubrics_metrics.name: Corrections and Other Changes in the International Register
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedures and standards for requesting corrections or other changes in the international register relating to design registrations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Statement of Grant of Protection
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules and procedures regarding issuance of a statement of grant of protection for international design registrations designating the United States.

rubrics_metrics.name: Grant of Protection Only Upon Issuance of Patent; Term of Design Patent
rubrics_metrics.description: Statement that grant of protection is conditioned upon issuance of a U.S. design patent and rules governing the term of the design patent.
